title: PerfectOpenGluingDataOfGlobalModel
statement: For any morphism g:X→Y of schemes with shared derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category], a perfect object A on Y [def-pc-perfect-complex] and an isomorphism Lg*A ≅ E [def-pc-derived-pullback], there is PerfectOpenGluingData(g,E) [def-pc-perfect-open-gluing-data]. No geometric finiteness or colimit hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 09RF, construction of the adjoint maps a,b and descent of c, before Tag 08DG

proof.text: Exact open restriction is derived pullback by uniqueness of the left derived functor; it preserves perfectness.

Choose the derived adjunction and take the adjoint of the global comparison. Use the top open twice. Naturality of the pullback/restriction comparison and the inverse Hom equivalence identify both restricted counit composites with restrictions of the original isomorphism. Their invertibility and the reflexive overlap equation supply the gluing datum.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_open_gluing_data_of_global_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hA : Y.IsPerfect A)
    (e : (derivedPullback g).obj A ≅ E) : PerfectOpenGluingData g E
